title: Soft
text: Soft. This blanket is super soft. The color is so pretty. However, it is super thin. The weave is very loose. It leaves fuzz absolutely everywhere. I haven't tried to wash it yet, but I do not imagine that will go well given the loose weave and the fringe. It looks nice, but it is very impractical.
